featureCards.text: 01 Raise the Arc Players train the ball to clear the guide, building a higher trajectory and softer entry angle.
02 Create Instant Feedback The tool makes misses and flat reps visible, so correction happens during the workout.
03 Build Repeatable Mechanics Arc, release point, and touch are connected to a standard the player can feel and repeat.
04 Connect Skill Work to Results The same feedback can support shooting workouts, finishing touch, and post-player development.
